observation: 作者明确建议程序员在两种长线名称中优先使用前者，而不是后者。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
one is recommended to use even-numbered line pairs in
preference to odd-numbered ones
observation: 作者建议优先使用偶数编号的线对，而非奇数编号线对，尤其涉及连续线段时。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
We shall describe the machine by ﬁrst explaining the behaviour of another machine
obtained by omitting from the Mark II machine a number of its parts and facilities.
This machine will be called the ‘reduced machine’. The full Mark II machine can
then be described in terms of a number of modiﬁcations of the reduced machine.
observation: 作者选择先描述一个删去若干部件的“reduced machine”，再把完整 Mark II 机作为该机器的修改来叙述。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
We are not however interested in the state of the machine at every moment from
a programming point of view. We shall be content to know its state at isolated
moments such that we can reasonably say that the machine has carried out one ‘step’
observation: 作者明确选择只关心机器在孤立时刻的状态，并把两个时刻之间的过程定义为一步。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The step from writing Φ(Σ) to writing Ψ( I(Σ), Σ) is not by itself a very
helpful one, for any function Φ could be expressed in this form (e.g. even if I(Σ)
always had the same value for every Σ). But there are restrictions on the form of Ψ
which do make this step helpful.
observation: 作者判断从 Φ(Σ) 改为 Ψ(I(Σ),Σ) 这一形式化步骤本身帮助不大，只有加上对 Ψ 的形式限制后才变得有帮助。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
This permits us 64 function symbols but (in the reduced machine) we
shall assume that only the nine listed below ever occur.
observation: 作者在简化机中把 64 个函数符号收窄为只出现下面列出的 9 个。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: Both methods have their weaknesses.

location.section: 5 Examples of programmes on the reduced machine

observation: 作者明确认为理论验证与实验验证两种方法各有弱点。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
In order to be able to express these matters clearly it is necessary to have notations
which draw the essential distinctions, though these distinctions may appear pedantic

location.section: 6 The multiplier and the double length accumulator

observation: 作者明确表示，需要引入能区分‘行’与‘数’的记号，即使这种区分显得学究气。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: We may allow certain abbreviations as admissible, viz.
observation: Turing 明确声明允许采用某些缩写，这是对符号记法的一种方法选择。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: extra line is not very practical
observation: 明确判断在检查表中使用额外行记录指令不实用，体现了对记录方式的偏好。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: Dummy stops are very useful in testing routines.
observation: 作者明确判断 dummy stops 在测试例程中非常有用。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
It is
thought to be unnecessary to make arrangements to transfer the two halves of a track
to any two tubes.

location.section: Detailed coding of the magnetic transfers

observation: 作者认为没有必要为把一条轨道的两半传送到任意两个管子而作安排。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
It is convenient to place
these spares in such a way that the various diﬀerent parts do not overlap teleprinter
characters thus
observation: 作者明确表示，将备用位安排为不与电传字符重叠是方便的，这体现了其对指令编码布局的偏好。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
This apparently somewhat involved process is designed to make
the hand punching of material as simple as possible.
observation: 作者将这种看似繁琐的 J 编码流程的目的描述为让手工穿孔尽可能简单，体现了以操作简便性为方法取舍标准的明确判断。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The user is recommended to avoid such
manual instructions.
observation: 作者明确建议用户避免使用这类手动指令。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The most satisfactory ar-
rangement in the opinion of the writer is to operate KLC whenever an error is made
observation: 作者明确判断在写入出错时最满意的做法是操作 KLC 并重写该行。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
At present it is proposed to keep only the powers of two and the ‘routine
changing sequence’.

location.section: The permanent information PERM. The routine changing sequence

observation: 作者当前只把2的幂和例程更换序列设为常驻信息，体现了对PERM内容的最小化取舍。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
any deviation from which must be noted in the descriptions of the
routines in which they occur.
observation: 作者规定偏离约定的情况必须在相关例程描述中注明。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: It seems preferable that these should be chosen amongst the ﬁrst eight,

location.section: Restricted use of electronic stores. Normal duties of pages.

observation: 作者明确判断应优先从首批八个页面中选取可用的电子存储页面。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: This is essential if library routines are used.

location.section: Restricted use of electronic stores. Normal duties of pages.

observation: 作者断言固定的五页选择不可更改是使用库例程的必要条件。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The advantage of working in the formal
mode is that the output recorded by the printer gives a complete description of what
was done in any computation.
observation: Turing 认为 formal mode 的优点是打印输出完整描述计算过程，可作为审查依据。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
xi) When a choice of B lines is available the higher number is to be
preferred.
observation: 在 B-tube 使用约定中，Turing 规定 B 线可选时优先选择编号较高者。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: one must decide what mathematical formulae are to be used.
observation: 明确表达了必须决定使用何种数学公式这一方法判断。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The plan should take this into account
to some extent, though a true optimum cannot be achieved except by chance, since
programmers’ time is involved, so that a determination of the optimum would defeat
its own ends.
observation: 作者明确认为，追求真正最优化的计算方案会适得其反，因为程序员时间也是成本，因此只能在一定程度上权衡。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: not at pages which are chock-full, but say at ones which are about ﬁve-eighths full.
observation: 作者在页面填充标准上明确反对写满，主张约八分之五满。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The extra space is best left between sequences of consecutive instructions, so that once
sequence may be extended without interfering with another.
observation: 作者建议将预留空间留在连续指令序列之间，以便扩展一个序列而不干扰另一个序列。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
It is never too soon to learn the meanings of the 64 functions [i.e., the opcodes]. The
way to do so is to start programming in teleprint code straight away.

location.section: Do programming directly in teleprint code

observation: 文中明确建议直接以 teleprint code 编程并随时查表来学习操作码，认为这样能很快掌握常用码。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: The repetitive part should preferably be programmed as follows:
observation: 文中用“preferably”给出了计数循环中重复部分的推荐编程写法，体现对循环结构安排的明确偏好。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
When two cases have to be given quite diﬀerent treatment, involving diﬀerent se-
quences of instructions, it is natural to choose the relevant sequences by a test in-
struction (i.e. conditional transfer /T, /H, /M, or /O). When there is a large number
the best method is to manufacture a control transfer number which will lead to the
appropriate sequence.
observation: 该段对比分支数量不同时的处理方式：两分支可用测试指令自然选择，分支数量大时作者称最好制造控制转移数来进入对应序列。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The instructions TT, TZ, TL were introduced in deference to this view; they do not
improve speed or reduce space, but they may save a little programmer’s time.
observation: 作者说明 TT/TZ/TL 指令是为顺应上述观点而引入，虽不改善速度或空间，但可节省程序员时间。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
If the operation to be repeated contains rather few instructions e.g. three, and is
crucial for the speed of the whole process it may be best to omit the instructions
concerned with counting and to repeat the instructions concerned with the process in
question the requisite number of times.
observation: 作者建议当重复操作仅含少量指令且对速度关键时，可省略计数指令而直接重复相关指令。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
In other cases, viz. page 0 routines and page 1
routines with true cue, these digits must be left blank. They have to be ﬁlled
in diﬀerently in diﬀerent applications.

location.section: 17 The oﬃcial account of a routine

observation: 作者指出在 page 0 例程和 true cue 的 page 1 例程中，cue 的检查字符无法预先给出，因此规定留空并在具体应用中另行填写。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
(i) The name of the routine. The length of this must not exceed 25 characters,
and should aim at about eight. It should preferably be pronounceable, and give some
indication of the purpose of the routine.

location.section: 17 The oﬃcial account of a routine

observation: 作者为子程序命名设定长度上限、约八字符、可发音且提示用途的明确偏好，体现对命名可读性和实用性的判断。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
These variable subroutines will be subject to numerous restrictions imposed by
the master routine, e.g. certain store lines, used by the master routine must not
be used by the subroutine, and the results must be given in a speciﬁed form.

location.section: 17 The oﬃcial account of a routine

observation: 作者规定可变子程序必须受主程序约束，不能占用主程序存储行且结果须按指定形式给出，体现接口约定的操作习惯。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
It is always recommended that single page routines be given an alternative cue
which results in both halves of its track being read. This is the easier alternative
to use in cases where the routine is not used in conjunction with another one-page
routine.

location.section: 17 The oﬃcial account of a routine

observation: 作者在比较中称替代 cue 在单页程序不与另一单页程序联用时是“更容易”的方案，暴露其以易用性为评价标准。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt: It is always recommended that single page routines be given an alternative cue
observation: 作者明确推荐单页例程提供替代提示。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
In so far as the master routine is non-repetitive this is no slower
than putting a master routine away in the magnetic store and then entering it.
observation: 文中对比 INPUT 纸带主控与先存入磁存储两种做法，以“不更慢”作为该方法的优点。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
Even when a certain amount of repetition is involved it may be less trouble to
have repetition e.g. by copying on the tape rather than to attempt to produce a
routine in which the repetition is achieved by passing through the same instructions
again and again.
observation: 文中对比把重复内容复制到纸带与用循环指令实现重复，认为前者更省事。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
The description to be given here will
apply to the most recent form of the machine.
observation: 明确选择以机器最晚近的形式作为描述对象。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
When nothing is stated to the contrary the equations A′ = A, C′ = C + 2, S′ = S,
P′ = P hold.
observation: 以“未作相反说明时”的方式给出默认方程（A′=A, C′=C+2, S′=S, P′=P）作为基线约定。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
An input routine might have been used accepting the same type of signals, but such
a system would not have been very ﬂexible. It was arranged instead that the input
should be along six lines.

location.section: Input and Output on pilot machine

observation: 作者判断沿用同一类信号做输入会不够灵活，因此改为六线输入方案。

source_title: Programmers Handbook for the Manchester electronic computer
quote_or_excerpt:
It was often found more convenient
to use the logarithm and exponential, although much slower.
observation: 作者在对比中指出，虽然对数与指数慢得多，但常被认为更方便。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
The interdependence of the chemical and mechanical 
data adds enormously to the difficulty, and attention will therefore be confined, so far as is 
possible, to cases where these can be separated.
observation: 作者将研究范围限定在化学与力学可分离的情形，并把二者相互依赖视为困难来源。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
The mathematics of elastic solids is a well- 
developed subject, and has often been applied to biological systems. In this paper it is 
proposed to give attention rather to cases where the mechanical aspect can be ignored and 
the chemical aspect is the most significant. These cases promise greater interest, for the 
characteristic action of the genes themselves is presumably chemical.
observation: 作者对比已常用于生物系统的弹性固体数学，认为可忽略力学、突出化学的情形更有意义，因为基因作用本质上是化学的。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
But presumably these radicals act almost independently, so that it is unlikely that 
serious errors will arise through regarding the genes as molecules.
observation: 作者判断把基因当作分子处理不会产生严重误差，理由是这些基因团几乎独立起作用。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt: That at any rate is the procedure adopted in the few examples considered
observation: 作者确认，前文所述将 evocator 的时空分布预先给定并考虑其引发的化学反应的做法，是本文少数例子所采用的程序。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
The choice of the reactions to be discussed 
was dictated entirely by the fact that it was desirable that the argument be easy to follow.
observation: 作者明确表示，选择讨论哪些反应完全取决于‘让论证易于理解’这一愿望。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
It would be preferable if it was found possible to find more accurate laws 
concerning reactions and diffusion.
observation: 作者明确表示更倾向于找到关于反应和扩散的更精确定律。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
A great deal more attention will nevertheless be given to the 
breakdown of homogeneity. This is largely because the assumption that the system is still 
nearly homogeneous brings the problem within the range of what is capable of being treated 
mathematically.

location.section: 6. REACTIONSAND DIFFUSION IN A RING OF CELLS

observation: 作者明确以数学可处理性作为继续研究近均匀系统的主要理由，展示了一种方法选择偏好。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
Although all the possibilities are covered by the stationary and oscillatory alternatives 
there are special cases of them which deserve to be treated separately.
observation: 作者在已用稳态和振荡两类覆盖全部可能后，仍主张特殊情况应被单独处理，体现分类细化的方法偏好。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
Since the example to be given involves three morphogens it is not possible to use 
the formulae of tj 6. Instead, one must use the corresponding three morphogen formulae.
observation: 作者因示例涉及三种形态素而判断二形态公式不可用，明确改用对应的三形态公式。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
In this section some of the finer points concerning the development of wave patterns arc 
considered. These will be of interest mainly to those who wish to do further research on 
the subject, and can well be omitted on a first reading.
observation: 作者判断该节内容主要面向希望继续研究的人，并建议初读时可省略。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
There are two commonly occurring cases in which one can simplify this expression consider- 
ably without great loss of accuracy.
observation: 作者明确表示在两种常见情形下可以简化表达式且不会造成大的精度损失，体现其对近似化简的容忍与偏好。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
There are two commonly occurring cases in which one can simplify this expression consider- 
ably without great loss of accuracy.
observation: 作者把“不带来大的精度损失”作为简化该表达式的可接受标准。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
These two sources of irregularity are the most significant of those which arise from truly 
statistical cause, and are the only ones which are taken into account in the calculations 
whose results are given below.
observation: 片段显示作者在后续计算中只把两类统计不规则性来源纳入考虑。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt: It is preferable to assume that A is a 'fuel substance' (e.g. glucose)
observation: 作者明确偏好将 A 假设为一种'燃料物质'。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
The specimens 
differ merely in the chance factors which were involved.
observation: 作者设置的两个样本仅在涉及的随机因素上不同。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt: merely for the purpose
observation: 作者明确表示球形壳假设仅为数学简化目的，体现了对简化假设的定位。

source_title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
quote_or_excerpt:
The 'wave' theory which has been developed here depends essentially on the assumption 
that the reaction rates are linear functions of the concentrations, an assumption which is 
justifiable in the case of a system just beginning to leave a homogeneous condition.
observation: 作者明确判断，反应速率与浓度线性相关的假设仅在系统刚开始离开均匀态时是合理的。

source_title: Finite Approximations to Lie Groups
quote_or_excerpt:
We choose an element in each coset of N as a repre-
sentative of that coset and define the function v(a)(a in H) to be the repre-
sentative of the coset in which a lies.
observation: 作者通过为 N 的每个陪集选取一个代表元、定义 v(a) 为 a 所在陪集的代表，来构造近似群 K。
